rank_independence: Rotation acts on geometric octants and labels, never on permutation_rank. All ranks inherit the same proof.
invariant: p(R)=min positive n such that R^n=identity; octant orbit period may be a proper divisor of p(R). Preserve rotation ancestry independently of observed state.
scientific_scope: Symbolic discrete cube symmetries, not a measured ultraviolet/infrared or particle physics conservation law.
